name: Hunger, Calories, Macronutrients & Energy Balance Runtime
design_rules: energy balance depends on intake minus metabolic and activity demand
hunger is related to energy and satiety but is not identical to either
foods provide different calorie and macronutrient profiles
calorie sufficiency does not guarantee balanced nutrition
protein fat and carbohydrate deficits can coexist independently
energy deficit reduces stamina and recovery progressively
food intake and nutrient state persist across world time
nutrition never uses emissive or glow feedback
